page_title: MON 0-3 AUG | B. Monchengladbach v Augsburg 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+4' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
90+3' One of the B. Monchengladbach players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
90+3' One of the players from Augsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+2' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) takes a short corner kick.
90+2' Arne Maier (Augsburg) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. Augsburg win a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
88' Augsburg hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
86' Tobias Sippel (B. Monchengladbach) is about to take a goal kick.
86' A snap shot by Mert Komur (Augsburg) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
84' One of the B. Monchengladbach players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
84' Mert Komur (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Tobias Sippel comes off his line to gather the ball.
83' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) attempts to convert the resulting set piece, but his miskick only goes way over the crossbar. A poor shot!
82' Tactical foul in the middle of the pitch interrupts the opponent's attacking opportunity. Marius Wolf (Augsburg) sets up the ball and will be the one to take this free kick.
81' Augsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
76' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Tim Kleindienst and he is replaced by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
76' Substitution. Julian Weigl makes his way off the pitch and Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) comes on as his replacement.
75' Jess Thorup prepares a substitution. Kristijan Jakic is replaced by Mert Komur (Augsburg).
74' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the top left corner and forces a good save out of Tobias Sippel.
73' The ball is behind the sideline. Marius Wolf (Augsburg) takes a throw-in.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Phillip Tietz leaves the pitch and Samuel Essende (Augsburg) comes on.

70' 0 - 3 Goal! Dimitrios Giannoulis produces a great pass that finds Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nathan Ngoumou will be replaced by Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach).
68' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Philipp Sander.
68' Steve Mounie (Augsburg) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.

68' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) receives a cross on the edge of the box. He doesn't hesitate and fires a bullet towards the goal. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper had no trouble dealing with his shot.
65' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
64' A long pass, executed by Marius Wolf (Augsburg), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will take a throw-in.
61' 0 - 2 Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
61' Augsburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
60' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Frank Onyeka trots off the pitch and is replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
58' Here is a change. Fredrik Jensen is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Steve Mounie (Augsburg).
58' That's the end of the game for Cedric Zesiger, who is replaced by Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg).
55' 0 - 1 Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
53' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he sends his effort over the crossbar.
52' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
51' A player from Augsburg brings down an opponent and commits a foul.

49' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
48' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
47' One of the Augsburg players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.
46' The whistle blows and Florian Exner starts the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' A player from Augsburg takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+3' An attempted cross from Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is cleared.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.
45' The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
45' Augsburg exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
43' A corner kick by B. Monchengladbach is thwarted by the well prepared Finn Dahmen (Augsburg).

43' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Finn Dahmen leaps like a salmon to deny him. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. They send men into the box.
40' A clumsy foul by Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) and Florian Exner blows his whistle.
37' Finn Dahmen makes a wonderful save! Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) got to the rebound and sent in a fine header to the middle of the goal, but he couldn't beat the keeper.

36' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
36' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to B. Monchengladbach.
34' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
34' Ooh that was close! Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
32' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kevin Stoger walks off the pitch to be replaced by Tobias Sippel (B. Monchengladbach).
28' Jonas Omlin (B. Monchengladbach) takes out his opponent with a nasty slide tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!

24' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
23' A player from B. Monchengladbach pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
22' The linesman signals a throw-in for B. Monchengladbach.
18' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Exner had an easy-decision to make.
15' The ball is behind the touchline and Augsburg will take a throw-in.
13' It must be a yellow card. It is. Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
11' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) commits a rough foul. Florian Exner stops the game and makes a call.
10' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) heads on.
8' The corner from Marius Wolf (Augsburg) is straight at the keeper, who can only punch the ball away.
8' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
7' Augsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
7' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Corner kick. Augsburg will have an opportunity.
4' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
2' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! B. Monchengladbach will take the kick-off.
Today's kick-off has been delayed due to heavy traffic en route to the stadium.
Florian Exner was nominated as the referee for this game.
